answer: Random liability pods: every 10 epochs the protocol shuffles agents into pods of five, cemented like polyps on a reef. If a podmate is later proven sybil, the other four forfeit 10% of the locked rewards they earned together, so strangers become motivated auditors, each with one free deep-check per epoch on a podmate. A farmer can't pick pods: in a 1,000-agent meadow, a 100-clone fleet would find ~90% of its podmates honest and watching. A pod that clears three shuffles clean earns a lotus mark: trust grown out of shared mud.
